newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil quiet in thin market.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil quiet in thin market.

text.p: Straight run fuel faced a quiet day on Friday in Europe with much of the market still enjoying Christmas holidays.
"The few people who are in are not particuarly anxious to trade," commented one dealer.
Low sulphur activity, slow before the holiday break, was even slower today. Traders said demand was not seen.
News on Friday that Russia was preparing documents on levying a fuel oil duty failed to ignite interest.
"We've known that for ages, we are just waiting to see when and how much," said one trader.
